## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Responsive and keyboard behavior checked where applicable
- [ ] Internal links checked
- [ ] Public-safety boundary checked

## Git convention

- [ ] Branch follows `<type>/<kebab-case-description>`
- [ ] PR title follows `<type>(optional-scope): imperative summary`
- [ ] Branch type still matches the final change scope

## Claim boundary

- Implementation, deployment, runtime use, and adoption are stated separately.
- Unknown or unverified outcomes remain explicit.
